en: The image shows a mid-20th-century modernist hotel or resort building with several balconies, surrounded by lush greenery and trees. There are people sitting at tables on a terrace, and several cars typical of Eastern Bloc countries from the 1970s–1980s are parked out front. The building has a sign with the word 'Felix' in red and a green clover logo. A parking sign ('P') is also visible.
